Controls

X
⌨
Keyboard & Mouse
WASD to move, left click to strike (hold to keep attacking), right click to dodge. Touch controls keep working.

Click a key to change it, then press the new key. Esc cancels, Backspace clears. W A S D are always movement. Your cursor aims strikes and skills when it is over an enemy.
